scope: Receive by candidate SHA the four metadata pages COAC-247 produced and audited (nemata-jp 1/2/3/317), dedupe them against the existing repair list, and establish what is actually repairable on each. No re-production, no re-audit, no model calls this round.

intake.dedupeMethod: candidateSha256 against the existing objects list
intake.verification: candidate file SHA-256, audit file SHA-256, audit.production.sha256 binding, audit.status, auditorScriptSha256 and deterministicChecks.passed were each recomputed from disk; all 8 hashes match the handoff exactly.

resolutionCeiling.finding: Every failing item on all four pages is microprint inside a low-resolution bitmap embedded in the source PDF. The embedded asset size is the ceiling: rendering the page at any DPI adds no information.

observedAt8xAnd16x.nemata-jp-p1-r4: The line under 「January」 stays an unreadable teal smear at 16x. Confirmed unreadable.
observedAt8xAnd16x.nemata-jp-p317-r6: The two top-right tagline lines are PARTIALLY legible at 8x: 「…ネット麻雀ライフを」 / 「…するマガジン」. Their leading characters remain mushy and are not reliably readable. Recorded as evidence only, not transcribed.

resolutionCeiling.conclusion: No local source satisfies the audit's stated repair direction (取得足以辨读该处小字的图像). A genuinely higher-resolution cover has to come from outside this PDF, or the items have to be settled by a root ruling.

results.outcome: passes the deterministic gate; would then require the independent model review

translationDefect.sourceText: 新現代⿇雀技術論にて発表中の最新版戦術論を暫定公開。
translationDefect.from: 暂时公开正在《新现代麻将技术论》中发表的最新版战术论。
translationDefect.to: 以暂定版形式公开正在《新现代麻将技术论》中发表的最新版战术论。
translationDefect.why: 暫定公開 qualifies the publication mode (provisional edition, matching the following ※暫定版の為 note), not a temporary public window.

page317RepairProbe.blocker: The route edits only string fields. A b5-only revision is rejected because the original audit's uncertain:nemata-jp-p317-r6 is unaddressed. Addressing r6 requires editing transcription, but the stale, now-contradictory unknowns entry (an ARRAY) cannot be rewritten through this route — applyReplacements only accepts string fromValue/toValue. So even the counterfactual b5+r6 revision would carry a self-contradictory record.

disposition.nemata-jp:1: blocked-unresolved-evidence — sole failure is p1-r4 microprint under 「January」, unreadable at the asset ceiling.
disposition.nemata-jp:2: blocked-unresolved-evidence — p2-r11 / p2-r15 microprint and unreadable tile faces in a 306x444 cover bitmap.
disposition.nemata-jp:3: blocked-unresolved-evidence — p3-r1 / p3-r3 unreadable microprint in 300x443 / 272x444 bitmaps.
disposition.nemata-jp:317: blocked-two-fold — real translation defect at b5 that the current route cannot express alone; r6 microprint partially legible but not fully, and the route cannot rewrite the unknowns array.

decisionsNeeded: Page-scoped evidence entry for the cover-microprint pages: authorise an exact-field route that also accepts `unknowns` array changes, so a partial-legibility finding can be recorded without contradiction.
Or: supply a higher-resolution source for the covers (the PDF's embedded assets are 272-416 px wide, ~300 DPI native).
Or: confirm these four front-matter pages stay permanently unresolved-evidence and are excluded from the corpus rather than blocked forever.
